sources.title: Supergirl S01E20 Better Angels recap - ew.com
sources.verification: Picks up with Kara and Alex about to fight. Eliza and J'onn arrive, Eliza talks Alex back through memory of her father. Kara broadcasts message of hope, House of El emblem wakes everyone. Non and Indigo plan to kill all humans, leave Kara as queen of dead Earth. Max tells Kara 4 hours left, suicide mission, no backup (J'onn wounded, Superman unconscious). Max tracks signal to Fort Rozz. J'onn rips Indigo in half, Kara burns Non's eyes out with heat vision. Indigo locked the Myriad system - only way to save everyone is flying Fort Rozz into space (Kara will die). Kara does it anyway. Alex rescues her in Kara's pod. J'onn pardoned and reinstated as DEO head. Cat promotes Kara. General Lane gives Max the Omegahedron. Kryptonian pod cliffhanger.

sources.verification: Kara's goodbye tour (Winn, Cat, James, J'onn). Lucy stands up to General Lane, mentions Lois. Alex tells Eliza Jeremiah is alive at Cadmus. Max tracks signal to Fort Rozz in Nevada (US government had cloaked it). J'onn and Kara fight Non and Indigo. J'onn rips Indigo in half, Kara overpowers Non's heat vision. Indigo reveals signal no longer from Omegahedron, can't be stopped. Kara flies Fort Rozz into space, lets go, floats unconscious. Alex arrives in Kara's pod to rescue her. J'onn reinstated, co-directs DEO with Lucy. Cat gives Kara a promotion and new office, finally calls her Kara not Kira. James gives Kara framed photo and kisses her. Dinner toast to family. Kryptonian pod crashes - cliffhanger.
